name: Marengo
long_description:
Marengo designs data centers in half the time and half the cost with AI. We’re working with some of the largest data center builders in the world to improve how design is done today.

We're backed by Y Combinator, a16z & Index Venture Scout Funds, as well as investors/angels in OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceX, and more.

Our advisors include the former President & CEO of Saipem America ($3B+ P&L), former President of Exyte's Advanced Technology Facilities GBU ($6B+ P&L) and more.
one_liner: AI-Native Engineering Firm designing Data Centers
